scenarios.name: Normal Day
scenarios.description: All trains run on schedule. Conflicts arise naturally on the single-line blocks (PWL-KSV and KSV-MTJ).

scenarios.name: Rajdhani 20 min Late
scenarios.description: Down Rajdhani 12956 enters the section 20 minutes late, creating a crossing conflict on the single line.

scenarios.name: Signal Failure at Kosi Kalan
scenarios.description: A signal failure at KSV slows all trains through block B4 to 40 km/h for 40 minutes.

scenarios.name: Freight Breakdown
scenarios.description: Up freight train breaks down at Palwal loop for 25 minutes, blocking a loop and forcing re-ordering.

scenarios.name: Fog / Speed Restriction
scenarios.description: Dense fog reduces max speed to 60 km/h across the whole section for one hour.
